research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Checkr is focusing on developing systems for continuous background check monitoring. This involves a computing system that electronically monitors data sources for updates or changes in a candidate's background check data until the candidate is no longer enrolled. This technology aims to automate and streamline the process of professional background checks, ensuring timely updates and accuracy in monitoring candidate information.

overview_description.description: Checkr is a software company that provides background screening and workforce monitoring services for businesses. Its platform includes features such as criminal record checks, employment and education verifications, driving record assessments, drug testing, and international screenings. Employers can initiate background checks through a dashboard, selecting screening packages tailored to specific job requirements. The process involves candidates providing necessary information and consent, with both parties able to track progress via the platform. Checkr's services are utilized by companies across various industries, including gig economy platforms and traditional employers. The company emphasizes compliance with relevant hiring laws and aims to streamline the screening process through technology,

about_short_description.short_description: Checkr is a software company that provides background screening and workforce monitoring services for businesses.

product.name: Checkr Workforce
product.description: An employment screening platform for running background checks and verifications, managing adjudication, and supporting compliant hiring workflows.

product.name: Checkr AI
product.description: An AI-powered verification platform that analyzes identity, background, and credential data to support faster, more consistent decisions in hiring, lending, leasing, and risk management.

product.name: Checkr Mortgage
product.description: An income, employment, and asset verification service for mortgage lenders that automates borrower verification and reduces manual document collection.

product.name: Checkr Tenant
product.description: An automated tenant-screening service that combines criminal history and income verification to help property managers evaluate rental applicants.

product.name: Checkr Trust
product.description: An API-driven risk intelligence service that provides criminal, identity, and driver information for trust and safety decisions.

product.name: Checkr Personal
product.description: A personal verification profile that lets individuals verify and share their identity, safety history, and credentials with employers, landlords, platforms, and marketplaces.
